title: 2025 Interim Results
text: BOC Group's operating income reached RMB 329.4 billion in the first half of 2025, representing a year-on-year increase of 3.61%.

title: 2025 Interim Results
text: Net fee and commission income increased by 9.17% in the first half of 2025.

title: 2025 Interim Results
text: Profit after tax attributable to Bank of China equity holders was RMB 117.6 billion, remaining stable year-on-year.
annotation_notes: Profit remained stable; no explicit improvement.

title: 2025 Interim Results
text: The net interest margin was 1.26% in the first half of 2025.

title: 2025 Interim Results
text: Bank of China's total assets reached RMB 36.79 trillion at the end of June 2025, an increase of 4.93% from the end of the previous year.
annotation_notes: Asset growth treated as positive under the annotation guidelines.

title: 2025 Interim Results
text: The core tier-1 capital adequacy ratio and capital adequacy ratio reached 12.57% and 18.67%, respectively.

title: 2025 Interim Results
text: The non-performing loan ratio decreased by 0.01 percentage point to 1.24% at the end of June 2025.
annotation_notes: Lower NPL ratio indicates improved asset quality.

title: 2025 Interim Results
text: The provision coverage ratio for non-performing loans was 197.39%.

title: 2025 Interim Results
text: BOC's total liabilities reached RMB 33.66 trillion, up 4.85% from the end of last year.
annotation_notes: Liability growth is not inherently favorable or unfavorable.

title: 2025 Interim Results
text: The return on equity was 9.11% and the cost-to-income ratio stood at 25.11%.

title: Bank of China posts 2.18% rise in 2025 profit
text: Bank of China's 2025 earnings were reported against a backdrop of property-sector debt problems and a prolonged economic slowdown affecting China's banking industry.
annotation_notes: mixed_direction: industry-wide negative backdrop; event date 2026-03-30 overlaps BOC_EXT_004 (same profit release)

title: China's big banks warn of more margin pressure in the second half
text: Bank of China's net interest margin declined in the first half of 2025, reflecting pressure on lending profitability amid lower interest rates.

title: Bank of China's 2024 profit beat forecasts, while margin pressure persists
text: Bank of China reported an increase in bad loans from its personal business lending and mortgage businesses, indicating continued asset quality pressure.
annotation_notes: mixed_direction: reported adverse asset-quality trend while the underlying article also shows rising profit and falling headline NPL

title: Bank of China 2025 Annual Report - capital adequacy
text: Bank of China's capital adequacy ratio reached 18.85% at the end of 2025, the highest year-end level on record, up 9 basis points from the prior year-end, while the core tier-1 capital adequacy ratio rose 33 basis points to 12.53%.

title: Bank of China discloses RMB 97.9 million regulatory penalty
text: Bank of China received a penalty decision from the National Financial Regulatory Administration on 30 October 2025 and was fined RMB 97.9 million for inadequate prudence in business management related to corporate governance, loans, interbank business, bills, asset quality and disposal of non-performing assets.

title: Bank of China 2025 third-quarter report
text: For the first nine months of 2025, Bank of China's net interest income fell 3.04% year-on-year to RMB 325.792 billion while its net interest margin stood at 1.26%.

title: Bank of China's corporate property loan NPL ratio rose to 6.26%
text: Bank of China's corporate real-estate loan non-performing ratio rose to 6.26% at the end of 2025, an increase of 1.32 percentage points from the prior year-end and the highest among China's six largest state-owned banks.

title: Bank of China 2026 first-quarter report
text: Bank of China's asset impairment losses rose 18.73% year-on-year to RMB 238.286 billion in the first quarter of 2026, outpacing revenue growth, while the annualised return on equity declined 0.63 percentage points to 8.46%.
annotation_notes: mixed_direction: adverse impairment/ROE figures alongside headline profit growth

title: Bank of China underwrites EDP and REN green bonds in Portugal
text: Bank of China, which has operated a Lisbon branch for 13 consecutive years, acted as joint lead underwriter for green bonds issued by Portugal's EDP and REN in early 2026, raising EUR 650 million and EUR 300 million respectively.

title: Bank of China assists Guangdong in issuing offshore RMB local government bonds
text: Bank of China acted as joint global coordinator for Guangdong Province's 2026 offshore RMB local government bond issuance in Hong Kong, totalling RMB 7.5 billion, with the order book peaking above RMB 64 billion.
